Code

Source: R/code_mobject.R
CodeClass.Rd

A highlighted source code listing: monospaced Text() lines colored by token kind, optional line numbers, and a rounded background ("rectangle") or a window with three buttons ("window").

Highlighting follows upstream: when Python with the pygments module is available (found as python3 or python, or set with options(manimR.python = "/path/to/python")), every Pygments lexer and style works and the colors are exactly upstream's (CodeClass$get_styles_list() lists the styles). Without Pygments, a small built in tokenizer highlights R and Python comments, strings, numbers and keywords; other languages are shown in the foreground color. Its styles "vim" (default), "monokai", "emacs" and "default" reproduce the colors of the Pygments styles of the same names. A custom style is a named list like the entries of those styles, with fields background, line_number, text, comment, keyword, namespace, constant, operator_word, string and number; it always uses the built in tokenizer.

Fields: code_lines (a VGroup of Text() lines), line_numbers and background.

Usage

Code(
  code_file = NULL,
  code_string = NULL,
  language = NULL,
  formatter_style = "vim",
  tab_width = 4,
  add_line_numbers = TRUE,
  line_numbers_from = 1,
  background = c("rectangle", "window"),
  background_config = NULL,
  paragraph_config = NULL
)

Arguments

code_file

Path of a file with the code.

code_string

Alternatively, the code as a string.

language

A Pygments lexer name such as "r", "python", "c" or "javascript" (only "r" and "python" without Pygments); guessed from the file name or the code when NULL.

formatter_style

A Pygments style name or a named list of colors.

tab_width

Width of a tab in spaces.

add_line_numbers

Show line numbers.

line_numbers_from

First line number.

background

"rectangle" or "window".

background_config

Named list of arguments for the background SurroundingRectangle(); fill_color defaults to the style's background.

paragraph_config

Named list of Text() arguments for the code and line numbers: font (default "mono"), font_size (24), line_spacing (0.5, extra space between lines as a fraction of the font size, as upstream), disable_ligatures, and any other Text() option such as weight or slant. color is ignored; colors come from the style. alignment, width and height are ignored.

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

code <- "f <- function(x) {\n  # square it\n  x^2 + 1\n}"
Code(code_string = code, language = "r", background = "window",
     background_config = list(stroke_color = "maroon"))
#> <Code> 0 points, 3 submobjects
